sv.title: Mördade 18-åringens storasyster i rätten: ”Han var min bästa vän”
sv.summary: 18-åringen var på väg hem från skolan när han kallblodigt sköts till döds på en SL-buss. Under rättegången säger 18-åringens storasyster att hon direkt insåg att det rörde sig om en felskjutning. – Vi var inte bara syskon, vi var också bästa vänner, säger systern medan hon gråter.

en.title: Murdered 18-year-old's older sister in court: "He was my best friend"
en.summary: The 18-year-old was on his way home from school when he was shot dead in cold blood on an SL bus. During the trial, the 18-year-old's older sister says she immediately realised it was a case of mistaken identity. "We were not just siblings, we were also best friends," the sister says while crying.
